sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: A wiretapped phone call, Russian diplomats, fear of blackmail, a loose-slipped army general, and a White House in crisis.
sentences.zh: 一通被窃听的电话、俄罗斯外交官、对敲诈勒索的恐惧、一个管不住嘴的陆军将军，以及一个陷入危机的白宫。

sentences.en: From fateful call to resignation, the 47-day fall of Donald Trump's national security advisor, Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 从宿命的电话到辞职，唐纳德·特朗普的国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林的 47 天倒台史。

sentences.en: We tell the whole story.
sentences.zh: 我们来讲述完整的故事。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 2 月 15 日，星期三。

sentences.en: In early December, after Donald Trump's election, but before his inauguration, Washington is reeling
sentences.zh: 在 12 月初，唐纳德·特朗普当选之后、就职之前，华盛顿一片震动，

sentences.en: because what has been rumored for months is now being confirmed by American intelligence agencies.
sentences.zh: 因为流传了几个月的传言现在得到了美国情报机构的证实。

sentences.en: This just-in-to-CNN Russian hacker has managed to infiltrate the computer network at the Democratic
sentences.zh: 刚刚从美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）获悉，俄罗斯黑客成功渗透了民主党

sentences.en: National Committee.
sentences.zh: 全国委员会的计算机网络。

sentences.en: The United States formally charged that Russia organize the hacking of
sentences.zh: 美国正式指控俄罗斯组织了对

sentences.en: Democratic political sites and state election systeMs. The cyber attack on the Democratic National
sentences.zh: 民主党政治网站和各州选举系统的黑客攻击。针对民主党全国委员会

sentences.en: Committee and the email account of Hillary Clinton's campaign chairman was authorized by the
sentences.zh: 以及希拉里·克林顿竞选主席电子邮箱的网络攻击得到了

sentences.en: Russian government.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府的授权。

sentences.en: It's what federal officials are calling an extraordinary effort to influence the outcome of an American presidential election.
sentences.zh: 联邦官员称这是为影响美国总统大选结果而采取的非凡行动。

sentences.en: The growing consensus is that Russia chose sides in that election, and they chose Trump, now the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 日益形成的共识是，俄罗斯在那场选举中选边站了，他们选择了特朗普，也就是现在的当选总统。

sentences.en: President Obama, in the final days of his administration, is under pressure to respond more forcefully to those attacks and is drawing up a plan to retaliate against Russia.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统在其任期的最后几天面临着采取更有力措施回应这些攻击的压力，并正在制定报复俄罗斯的计划。

sentences.en: Our goal continues to be to send a clear message to Russia not to do this to us because we can do stuff to you.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标依然是向俄罗斯发出一个明确的信息：不要对我们这样做，因为我们也能对你们做些什么。

sentences.en: Amid all this, two men get on the phone, one from the United States, one from Russia.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，两个人通了电话，一个来自美国，一个来自俄罗斯。

sentences.en: The man from the United States is Lieutenant General Michael Flynn, a retired military officer, who is at this moment a
sentences.zh: 来自美国的人是迈克尔·弗林中将，一名退休军官，此时他是一个

sentences.en: private citizen, but within weeks will become the national security advisor for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 平民，但在几周内将成为唐纳德·特朗普的国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: The Russian is the Russian ambassador to the United States, Sergey I.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人是俄罗斯驻美国大使谢尔盖·I·

sentences.en: Kisilak.
sentences.zh: 基斯利亚克。

sentences.en: Matthew Rosenberg is a national security reporter in Washington.
sentences.zh: 马修·罗森伯格是华盛顿的一名国家安全记者。

sentences.en: He's been documenting this complicated series of events and has known Michael Flynn for years.
sentences.zh: 他一直在记录这一系列复杂的事件，并且认识迈克尔·弗林多年。

sentences.en: Flynn's this working-class kid from
sentences.zh: 弗林是个来自罗德岛的

sentences.en: Rhode Island.
sentences.zh: 工人阶级孩子。

sentences.en: He goes to University of Rhode Island, he does ROTC, gets into the military, and he rises through the ranks.
sentences.zh: 他去了罗德岛大学，参加了预备役军官训练营，进入军队，并一步步晋升。

sentences.en: He's an intelligence officer, and his star really begins to shine during the war in Iraq, where he's working for General Stanley McChrystal, and they're
sentences.zh: 他是一名情报军官，他的明星光芒真正开始闪耀是在伊拉克战争期间，当时他在斯坦利·麦克水晶将军手下工作，他们

sentences.en: dismantling al-Qaeda in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 在伊拉克清剿基地组织。

sentences.en: And Flynn kind of gains his reputation as having this amazing knack for kind of mapping out terrorist networks and dismantling them.
sentences.zh: 弗林也因此获得了享有盛誉的名声，他有一种绘制恐怖网络并将其瓦解的神奇本领。

sentences.en: And it's here that Flynn kind of becomes this kind of bigger-than-life figure.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，弗林变成了一个带有传奇色彩的人物。

sentences.en: He writes an entire report publicly criticizing how intelligence is collected and how it serves the war effort.
sentences.zh: 他写了一整份公开报告，批评情报收集的方式及其对战争的支援方式。

sentences.en: It really solidifies his reputation as this kind of brash, unconventional officer who's willing to buck the trend and tell the bureaucracy they're wrong.
sentences.zh: 这真正巩固了他的声誉，他是一个傲慢、不按常理出牌的军官，敢于打破常规，告诉官僚机构他们错了。

sentences.en: When he gets to Washington, suddenly he finds out he's under investigation because among his
sentences.zh: 当他来到华盛顿后，突然发现自己正在接受调查，因为他

sentences.en: unconventional way of doing business was he tried to share intel with the Pakistanis about some
sentences.zh: 不按常理办事的方式之一是试图与巴基斯坦人分享关于一些

sentences.en: Taliban terror networks.
sentences.zh: 塔利班恐怖网络的情报。

sentences.en: And his thinking there, which was kind of classic Flynn and somewhat
sentences.zh: 他当时的思维方式——这有点典型的弗林风格，也略带

sentences.en: McChrystal, was, we want to get the Pakistanis to help us, so we're going to try and shame them a little bit into doing this.
sentences.zh: 麦克水晶的风格——是，我们想让巴基斯坦人帮助我们，所以我们要试图用一点羞耻感来促使他们这么做。

sentences.en: We're going to tell them we know what they're up to and that they're helping these guys.
sentences.zh: 我们要告诉他们，我们知道他们在搞什么鬼，知道他们在帮助这些人。

sentences.en: But that was like CIA intelligence.
sentences.zh: 但那是中央情报局的情报。

sentences.en: They were pretty pissed about that.
sentences.zh: 他们对此非常生气。

sentences.en: All right, back to this call.
sentences.zh: 好的，回到这通电话。

sentences.en: Why is Michael Flynn having this conversation in December?
sentences.zh: 为什么迈克尔·弗林要在 12 月进行这次对话？

sentences.en: So, look, the Trump campaign is just one.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，特朗普竞选团队刚刚获胜。

sentences.en: Flynn is going to be their national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 弗林将成为他们的国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: He's going to be a point person on foreign affairs defense, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 他将成为外交事务、国防等方面的关键人物。

sentences.en: So he's part of the effort that any administration makes in a transition to reach out to allies, adversaries, kind of leaders
sentences.zh: 所以他是任何政府在过渡期间做出努力的一部分，旨在接触盟友、对手、世界各地的

sentences.en: and officials around the world and start establishing a relationship.
sentences.zh: 领导人和官员，并开始建立关系。

sentences.en: So this conversation goes from a typical courtesy call into a discussion of policy.
sentences.zh: 因此，这场对话从一次典型的礼节性拜访演变成了一场关于政策的讨论。

sentences.en: What policy specifically gets discussed?
sentences.zh: 具体讨论了什么政策？

sentences.en: They begin to talk about sanctions.
sentences.zh: 他们开始谈论制裁。

sentences.en: Now, the Obama administration at that point was, I think, a day away from imposing sanctions over the Russian election hacking.
sentences.zh: 当时，奥巴马政府距离因俄罗斯黑客攻击大选而实施制裁，我想只有一天时间了。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was kind of an open secret that it was coming.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这即将发生可以说是公开的秘密。

sentences.en: What we've been told is that the message Flynn delivered was pretty unambiguous.
sentences.zh: 我们所被告知的是，弗林传递的信息非常明确。

sentences.en: It was subtle, but pretty clear, which was that, look, anything that's happening, any sanctions that are coming, don't react, don't overreact.
sentences.zh: 它很微妙，但非常明确，那就是，看，无论发生什么，任何即将到来的制裁，都不要反应，不要过度反应。

sentences.en: The Obama administration is Russia's problem, not the United States.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府是俄罗斯的问题，而不是美国的问题。

sentences.en: When Trump is in office, there will be many avenues for cooperation.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普上台后，将会有很多合作途径。

sentences.en: So let's not mess anything up right now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在不要把事情搞砸。

sentences.en: So then these sanctions come.
sentences.zh: 接着这些制裁就来了。

sentences.en: How does Russia react?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯作何反应？

sentences.en: It doesn't.
sentences.zh: 没有反应。

sentences.en: I mean, it really just brushed them off.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它根本不把它们放在眼里。

sentences.en: And Trump also gets on Twitter saying, you know, Putin is really smart for not rising to the bait here.
sentences.zh: 特朗普也在推特上说，你知道，普京没有咬钩，真的很聪明。

sentences.en: It's an amazing kind of confluence of coincidences.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种奇妙的巧合汇聚。

sentences.en: You know, we can't connect all these dots here right now, but it does not look great.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们现在无法把所有这些线索连起来，但这看起来确实不太妙。

sentences.en: So the implication here very much seems to be that the muted response from Russia was maybe in part or even more because of Flynn and people like him.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的暗示在很大程度上似乎是，俄罗斯平淡的反应部分甚至更多是因为弗林这样的人。

sentences.en: What's technically wrong with that?
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，这有什么问题？

sentences.en: You know, it's legally, there's nothing wrong with it, you know, but it's really, really untoward to get on the phone with an adversary and say that the current president
sentences.zh: 你知道，从法律上讲，这没有什么问题，你知道，但是与对手通电话，说现任美国总统

sentences.en: of the United States to whom we're all supposed to be loyal.
sentences.zh: ——我们本都应该忠于他。

sentences.en: And Flynn certainly is at that point is wrong and just ignore them and to really undercut the actual government of the United
sentences.zh: 而弗林在当时显然做错了——说“不用理会他们”，并在那个时刻真正削弱了实际的美国

sentences.en: States at that moment.
sentences.zh: 政府，这是非常非常不合时宜的。

sentences.en: That's considered an incredible breach of protocol in Washington.
sentences.zh: 这在华盛顿被认为是极其违反议定书的行为。

sentences.en: And with good reason, you know, if you had a three month transition where you had two different camps kind of trying to make policy and telling foreign adversaries or allies how
sentences.zh: 这是有充分理由的，你知道，如果你有一个为期三个月的过渡期，期间有两个不同的阵营试图制定政策，并告诉外国对手或盟友事情将如何发展，

sentences.en: things are going to be, you couldn't run the country that way.
sentences.zh: 你就无法以这种方式治理国家。

sentences.en: Every four years, you'd have this great giant hole.
sentences.zh: 每四年，你就会留下这样一个巨大的黑洞。

sentences.en: And, you know, and I think a lot of Americans would find it pretty unseemly to get on the phone with a country like Russia that's just accused of trying to help win the election.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为许多美国人会觉得，和一个刚刚被指控试图帮助赢得选举的像俄罗斯这样的国家通电话，是一件很不体面的事。

sentences.en: And you're on the phone saying, hey, we're going to be friends with you too.
sentences.zh: 而你却在电话里说，嘿，我们也会和你们做朋友的。

sentences.en: Don't worry about the current people.
sentences.zh: 别担心现在这群人。

sentences.en: So this call is being recorded.
sentences.zh: 所以这通电话正在被录音。

sentences.en: Why is the call being recorded?
sentences.zh: 为什么要对电话进行录音？

sentences.en: And by whom is it being recorded?
sentences.zh: 又是谁在录音？

sentences.en: So it's the FBI listening.
sentences.zh: 是联邦调查局在监听。

sentences.en: The FBI has probably been listening to the Russian ambassador's phone calls since what, like 1942, the 30s?
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局可能从1942年、30年代左右就开始监听俄罗斯大使的电话了？

sentences.en: I mean, they've been listening to these phone calls for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们监听这些电话已经很久了。

sentences.en: So they picked this all up.
sentences.zh: 所以他们截获了这一切。

sentences.en: I think their initial concern was that the classified information was discussed.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们最初的担忧是讨论了机密信息。

sentences.en: They do at some point assess that, like, nobody broke any laws.
sentences.zh: 他们在某个时候确实评估认为，比如，没有人违反任何法律。

sentences.en: You're discussing classified information.
sentences.zh: 你在讨论机密信息。

sentences.en: But he did get on the phone and say, look, talk policy, talk about sanctions and undercut current American policy with the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 但他确实打了电话并说，看，谈论政策，谈论制裁，并与俄罗斯大使一起削弱当前的美国政策。

sentences.en: Well, who else might be eavesdropping on this call as well?
sentences.zh: 那么，还有谁也可能在窃听这通电话呢？

sentences.en: I mean, well, the Russians certainly were.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，俄罗斯人当然也在。

sentences.en: They were part of it.
sentences.zh: 他们是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: I mean, let's presume that they know everything about the call because the ambassador can report back exactly what was said.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们假设他们对这通电话的一切都了如指掌，因为大使可以确切汇报谈话内容。

sentences.en: Did they record it?
sentences.zh: 他们录音了吗？

sentences.en: Possibly.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We assume they did, but we're not sure.
sentences.zh: 我们假设他们录了，但我们不确定。

sentences.en: Yeah, not sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，不确定。

sentences.en: It was on their cell phones.
sentences.zh: 这是在他们的手机上。

sentences.en: It's kind of recording on a cell phone is a little bit of a pain in the butt.
sentences.zh: 用手机录音有点让人头疼。

sentences.en: Wouldn't someone like Flynn, given his military experience and the fact that he's about to become
sentences.zh: 像弗林这样的人，考虑到他的军事经验以及他即将成为

sentences.en: the national security advisor for the United States, wouldn't he have known that a call like this would be recorded by at least one side?
sentences.zh: 美国国家安全顾问的事实，难道他不会知道这样的电话至少会被一方录音吗？

sentences.en: You'd think.
sentences.zh: 你会这么想的。

sentences.en: You'd think he would know it was going to be recorded, but he wouldn't be the first and a long list of generals to do things that you'd think they would know better.
sentences.zh: 你会认为他知道会被录音，但他绝不是众多将军中第一个做出了明知故犯之事的人。

sentences.en: I mean, look at Dave Petraeus.
sentences.zh: 看看戴夫·彼得雷乌斯。

sentences.en: Not only was he having an affair with his biographer, they were using a Gmail dead drop, you know, as their kind of hidey hole to like exchange information.
sentences.zh: 他不仅与自己的传记作家有染，他们还使用 Gmail 的死信箱，你知道的，作为交换信息的藏身之所。

sentences.en: I mean, that was not exactly cutting edge.
sentences.zh: 我的意思那可不是什么尖端技术。

sentences.en: And this guy was running the CIA at the time.
sentences.zh: 而这家伙当时正掌管中央情报局。

sentences.en: I mean, love is blind.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，爱情是盲目的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And blinding.
sentences.zh: 而且使人盲目。

sentences.en: Did Flynn love the Russians?
sentences.zh: 弗林爱俄罗斯人吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But he certainly thought they could be good allies.
sentences.zh: 但他当然认为他们可以成为好盟友。

sentences.en: So once it's recorded, this telephone call, who finds out about the call?
sentences.zh: 所以一旦被录音，这通电话，谁发现了这通电话？

sentences.en: It starts filtering through the FBI.
sentences.zh: 它开始在联邦调查局内部流传。

sentences.en: They've got the national security advisor on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他们发现国家安全顾问在打电话。

sentences.en: They need to make sure no classified information is discussed.
sentences.zh: 他们需要确保没有讨论机密信息。

sentences.en: They're kind of looking at the call to make sure everything's kind of legal.
sentences.zh: 他们正在审查这通电话，以确保一切都合乎法律。

sentences.en: And it does seem unusual and it starts filtering way up and it gets to the Department of Justice and keeps kind of moving its way up there.
sentences.zh: 而且这确实显得很不寻常，它开始层层上报，并到达了司法部，并继续在那里流转。

sentences.en: The same time, for a second week of January, news media reports come out.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在 1 月的第二周，新闻媒体报道出炉了。

sentences.en: A bombshell out of Washington today.
sentences.zh: 今天来自华盛顿的重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: That Flynn had had this call with the ambassador.
sentences.zh: 弗林与大使有过这通电话。

sentences.en: That he discussed U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在特朗普总统上任之前就美国

sentences.en: sanctions with a Russian ambassador before President Trump took office.

sentences.en: Flynn will be replaced by 72-year-old retired General Keith Kellogg, a decorated veteran of the
sentences.zh: 接替弗林的将是72岁的退休将军基思·凯洛格，他是一位战功显赫的

sentences.en: Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 越战老兵。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Michael Flynn's problems are moving from the White House over to Congress.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林的麻烦正从白宫转移到国会。

sentences.en: Republican Senator Roy Blunt is calling for an exhaustive investigation into the Trump administration's connections to Russia.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员罗伊·布伦特正呼吁对特朗普政府与俄罗斯的联系进行详尽的调查。

sentences.en: I would think we should talk to General Flynn very soon, and that should answer a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该很快与弗林将军谈谈，这应该能解答很多问题。

sentences.en: What did he know?
sentences.zh: 他都知道些什么？

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: And is there any reason to believe that anybody else knew that and didn't take the kind of action they should have taken?
sentences.zh: 有什么理由相信其他人也知道这一点，却没有采取他们本该采取的行动吗？

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that the FBI interviewed Flynn about the call in late January.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，联邦调查局在1月下旬就那通电话对弗林进行了讯问。

sentences.en: That raises the stakes of the scandal.
sentences.zh: 这抬高了丑闻的赌注。

sentences.en: If Flynn wasn't entirely honest with the FBI, it could expose him to a felony charge.
sentences.zh: 如果弗林对联邦调查局不够诚实，这可能会让他面临重罪指控。

sentences.en: In non-Flynn news, an influential group of American scientists is supporting an idea that's
sentences.zh: 在弗林的相关新闻之外，一个有影响力的美国科学家群体正在支持一个

sentences.en: been ethically unacceptable for years, genetically engineering human embryos, but only to avoid babies being born with serious disease or disability.
sentences.zh: 多年来在伦理上无法被接受的想法：对人类胚胎进行基因工程改造，但仅限于避免婴儿出生时带有严重的疾病或残疾。

sentences.en: And finally, in New York, the 40-year-old murder case of Eitan Pates, the first missing child to be shown on a milk carton, has been solved.
sentences.zh: 最后来看纽约的消息，埃坦·佩茨案是一起尘封40年的谋杀案，埃坦也是第一个被印在牛奶盒上的失踪儿童，这起案件如今终于告破。

sentences.en: The Pates family has waited a long time, but we finally have found some measure of justice
sentences.zh: 佩茨一家等待了很久，但我们终于为我们可爱的小男孩埃坦

sentences.en: for our wonderful little boy, Eitan.
sentences.zh: 讨回了一定程度的正义。

sentences.en: In 1979, when he was six years old, Pates disappeared while walking to the school bus on his own for the first time.
sentences.zh: 1979年，六岁的佩茨在生平第一次独自走去坐校车时失踪。

sentences.en: A longtime suspect, who worked at a downtown convenience store on Pates' way to that bus stop, was convicted of murder and kidnapping on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周二，一名长期以来的嫌疑人因谋杀和绑架罪被定罪，他曾在佩茨去往那个公交车站路边的一家市中心便利店工作。

sentences.en: I'm really grateful.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: I'm really grateful that this jury finally came back with what I have known for a long
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激这个陪审团终于做出了我一直以来

sentences.en: time, that this man, Pedro Hernandez, is guilty of doing something really terrible so many years ago.
sentences.zh: 都知道的裁决，这个名叫佩德罗·埃尔南德斯的男人，在很多年前犯下了极其可怕的罪行。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们准备迎接节假日的宾客做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、一关灯就能深度睡眠的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片了才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索并收听《Wirecutter秀》。
